title: Squadle ⚽ — Think you know football? Try the beta.
author: DifferentJudgment844
selftext:
# I just launched a football player guessing game — and there's something in it you haven't seen before.

**Squadle is live, and I want the football community to try it.**

It's a football player guessing game — but before you scroll past thinking **“another Wordle clone…”**, here's what's different:

You don't just guess a name.

**You hunt down the player.**

📅 **Daily** — One mystery player. Everyone gets the same challenge. Can you crack it before your guesses run out?

🎲 **Free Play** — Can't wait until tomorrow? Pick up another game and keep playing.

And you've got **three difficulty levels**:

🟢 **Easy** — Ease into it.  
🟡 **Medium** — The mystery gradually reveals itself.  
🔴 **Hard** — The real test. Limited guesses. No face to bail you out.

And there's **one surprise waiting for anyone who conquers Hard Mode.** 👀

I'm keeping that part secret for now.

# 🧪 It's still in BETA

I'd genuinely love football fans to jump in, **challenge their mates**, and tell me what you think.

Find something annoying? Tell me.  
Think it's too easy? Prove it.  
Know someone who thinks they're a football encyclopedia? **Challenge them.** 😂

If you enjoy it, I'd really appreciate you **spreading the word** and helping get Squadle in front of more football fans.

👉 [**https://playsquadle.com/**](https://playsquadle.com/)

**Squadle — Think you know the player? Prove it.**
